print_go_env_exports: run env.py with no arguments to print export statements for the Go toolchain environment variables
wrap_go_command: run env.py go version to execute the go command with the hermetic Go toolchain environment
wrap_python_command: run env.py python script.py to execute a Python script with the Go toolchain environment variables set
prepare_go_environ: call bootstrap.prepare_go_environ to get a dictionary of environment variables for the hermetic Go toolset
find_executable_in_workspace: call bootstrap.find_executable with an executable name and workspace path to resolve its full path
